verdict.rationale: Persona documents a Hosted Flow, a Persona-hosted page users are redirected to, described as 'the fastest way without any code'. That supports no-code verification links, but the evidence never shows an ops user generating and sending a one-off link from a dashboard, and never mentions QR codes. Missing for 10: QR code generation, documented dashboard flow for an ops lead to create and send a one-off verification link without engineering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller

citations.quote: the fastest way without any code is to setup a Hosted Flow
Redirect users to a Persona-hosted page | Fastest setup, no frontend code required
Inquiry templates house the configuration for a single use case by defining the screens, verifications, decisioning, and theming.
